verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only real-time transcription to on-screen text, which is a speech-to-text feature. Nothing documents routing a live Video session into a model and then text-to-speech as a voice-agent pipeline. The 'Conversational AI' line in llms.txt refers to Twilio broadly, not to a Video integration path, so it is adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
